notes.title: Achievements hotfix

notes.title: Temporary fix for the Achievement bug in Shadows of Duat
notes.notes:
Some of your earned achievements may not appear on Steam. Fortunately, Shadows of Duat has an internal database that stores all of your achievements. As a temporary solution until we resolve the connectivity issues with Steam, we've created this tool, which you can access from the Main Menu, as shown in the video:

[previewyoutube=AaVAUaENVNI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

You'll now be able to view the game's internal achievement database. If any of your achievements are there but aren't reflected on Steam, you'll need to enter the encrypted name and number of the achievement, as shown in the video, and then click Check. If all goes well, Steam will give you the missing achievement.

notes.title: Another Achievement Hotfix
notes.notes: Maybe the last...

notes.title: Achievements Hotfix
notes.notes: We're continuing to work on fixing achievements. Now, from the Main Menu, if you tap the Achievements submenu, you'll see a small red button in the lower right corner of the screen. Clicking on it will show you the achievements you've earned according to the game's internal database. If any of these achievements appear here as completed but not on Steam, use the menu at the top of this new window to try to fix it. This system is still rudimentary and is in the testing phase.

notes.title: Fixing achievements
notes.notes: Thanks to a player reporting this, we learned that cumulative achievements were failing. We've made some changes that we believe may fix this, but we need to upload these changes to test them on the platform. This may fix it, or we may need to upload a new update in the next few hours. Fingers crossed!

notes.title: Minor hotfix
notes.notes: Fix minor bugs.

notes.title: Minor adjustments in Massacre mode
notes.notes:
More nooks and crannies to navigate the stage.

A 10-second break between rounds.

A few hidden secrets to make it more interesting...

notes.title: New Language Added: Thai
notes.notes: We've recently noticed a surge in purchases of our game in Thailand. As a thank you, we've decided to add this language so new Thai users can enjoy the game in their own language. We sincerely hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Just a few minor tweaks
notes.notes:
-UI fixes for accessing new game modes.
-Oil flasks will now appear more frequently when you're low on fuel in Challenge Mode.
-Improved dynamite's interaction with cauldrons.
-The An-Ren's arrow now lasts less time stuck in the character.
-When the An-Ren is defeated, the creatures it summoned disappear and the curses are dispelled.

notes.title: Improving Dynamite
notes.notes:
- Dynamite can now be equipped with hotkeys and auto-combines like ammo.

- Ushabti Warrior shields no longer suck dynamite into a space-time vortex as before.

- The explosion is now more beautiful and affects a larger area.

- Pressing the Aim button will allow you to throw dynamite farther.

notes.title: Explosive and Fun Upgrades
notes.notes:
You've been asking for this a lot, and it's finally here:

You can now equip dynamite and use it to blast enemies! Be careful, though, there's very little of it, and it's quickly consumed.

Another new feature is that when you have ammo of the same type in your inventory, it will automatically combine, which is very useful in frantic situations like those in Rampage Mode.

We've also fixed some issues related to quickly opening and closing Khepri's chest.

notes.title: New minnor fix on Massacre Mode
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bug where some enemies would appear clipped to a wall.
-Fixed a minor issue with opening Khepri's chest and opening the inventory too quickly.

notes.title: Last hotfix today
notes.notes: Seriously, it's the last one today, I promise.

notes.title: More improvements to Massacre Mode
notes.notes: Creating a new game mode is a slow process, like forging a sword. We're doing it in a weekend.

notes.title: Another hotfix

notes.title: Massacre mode hotfix
notes.notes: Fix minor bug in massacre mode.

notes.title: New Massacre mode and new languages!
notes.notes:
We're unleashed! We're bringing you a new game mode: Massacre Mode. Plus, you can finally enjoy the game in German, Russian, Portuguese, and Italian.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44216489/cf43005fdcd7ef46e5015129e4e97313c8a9b0ee.png[/img]

The new Massacre Mode is simple: waves of enemies will appear, and you must survive as long as possible. This game mode is endless; it ends the moment you die. And eventually, you will die, as increasingly powerful enemies will appear in greater numbers. It's not just about surviving; the ranking will be led by those who manage to kill the most enemies. To achieve this, you'll have a wide variety of weapons at your disposal. Good luck!

notes.title: Chalenge Mode Hotfix
notes.notes:
-You can now customize your gameplay experience in Challenge Mode by choosing difficulty, number of Sphinxes, and An-Ren phase.

-Rankings are now differentiated by difficulty.

-We've fixed the doors where the ushabti come out from, which were not displayed correctly.

notes.title: New Update: Challenge Mode!
notes.notes:
Get ready to test your skills and endurance with the new Challenge Mode in Shadows of Duat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44216489/7dc04a6618c304f8cbd88e84b8bcc71964fd615c.png[/img]

-Fight through relentless waves of terrifying enemies in an intense, action-packed level.

-Choose from a wide arsenal of weapons, survive as long as possible, and achieve the highest score.

-Compete against players worldwide and climb your way up the global leaderboards.

This mode complements the core game experience, offering an extra adrenaline-packed challenge.

Do you have what it takes to be the ultimate mummy hunter?

notes.title: New Update: Challenge Mode!
notes.notes:
Get ready to test your skills and endurance with the new Challenge Mode in Shadows of Duat.

- Fight through relentless waves of terrifying enemies in an intense, action-packed level.

- Choose from a wide arsenal of weapons, survive as long as possible, and achieve the highest score.

- Compete against players worldwide and climb your way up the global leaderboards.

This mode complements the core game experience, offering an extra adrenaline-packed challenge. Do you have what it takes to be the ultimate mummy hunter?

notes.title: The Challenge is here!
notes.notes: We are introducing a new game mode that is completely different from the main Campaign: The Challenge, a new game mode that has nothing to do with the story of the campaign. Here it is all about surviving, getting weapons and killing enemies to reach the last room. Only by defeating the Final Enemy in this last room will the Challenge be successfully completed. You will be able to see the best scores in a global ranking, where doing it in the shortest possible time will be valued above all else, although defeated enemies will also be taken into account. We recommend playing at least the first stages of the Campaign to master the game mechanics, since the Challenge does not include any kind of tutorial or help.

notes.title: More adjustments in new modes
notes.notes: The arcade and nightmare mode spawn more enemies.

notes.title: Little fix in the new modes
notes.notes: Little fix in the new modes: Arcade, Jumpscares and Nightmare.

notes.title: New Game Modes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44216489/63657cc14f31bee66230bff06b092a15d5ab65ba.png[/img]

Shadow of Duat was conceived with the idea of ​​being a classic survival horror. Now, in addition, you can choose new game modes that vary the original experience, thus expanding your options to have an experience to your liking.

-Arcade Mode: No puzzles, but with many more enemies and ammunition. For those of you who don't feel like eating your head and want to simply slaughter mummies without mercy.

-Jumpscare Mode: We don't particularly like scares, but we know that many do. By activating this option, we will make you jump out of your chair!

-Nightmare Mode: An impossible challenge, with many more, more powerful enemies... we would be surprised if anyone was able to overcome it. You'll probably end up crying.

notes.title: New game modes: Arcade, Jumpscare and Nightmare
notes.notes:
From now on you will be able to enjoy the Shadows of Duat experience in different ways, alternatives to the original game mode that will always be present, of course.

-Arcade Mode: For those people who don't like puzzles, just shoot shots.
-Jumpscare Mode: Although Shadows of Duat is not a game of scares, we know that some of you like them, therefore, we have created this option that you can activate or deactivate at any time.
-Nightmare Mode: A much greater challenge, only recommended for the toughest people. You will suffer to finish it in this mode.

notes.title: June update
notes.notes: Minor aesthetic and performance adjustments.

notes.title: We continue working on optimization
notes.notes: In our previous update we approached an optimization so that the game worked better on low-performance computers or Steamdeck. There were still some adjustments left and we are working on it.

notes.title: Optimization for Steamdeck
notes.notes: This new graphical optimization will improve overall performance and will also allow Steamdeck users to enjoy the game on their portable console.

notes.title: May 11 Updates
notes.notes: We have fixed several small bugs related to the new Story Mode.

notes.title: New achievements! And some fixes to the new Story Mode.
notes.notes:
We have added new achievements, such as "Untouchable", which you will only get if you finish the game without taking damage, or "Speedrunner", if you are able to complete the game in less than 3 hours.

We've also made some adjustments to the new Story Mode to ensure you have an enjoyable and balanced experience.

notes.title: New Story Mode and Achievement Rewards
notes.notes:
We present to you one of the most important changes since the game's launch: Story Mode. Many people have been asking us for it over the months and it is finally a reality. In this mode, you can enjoy the entire story but with a much simpler challenge: unlimited fuel and saves, more ammunition and healing items.

On the other hand, we have created a screen with those Achievements for which you obtain rewards, in the form of unlocking characters and new weapons. We will be adding more in the future.

We hope you like these new changes and that they help you have a better gaming experience.

notes.title: Changes to dodge mechanics and improved experience
notes.notes:
- You can now roll with the Alt button at any time to dodge enemy attacks.
- Toggling between fixed and sustained running modes is now in the Options menu.
- We have increased the amount of ammunition in some areas.
- Luzbel will sometimes bring valuable objects to the Sanctuary.
- We have adjusted the impact radius of the cauldrons to make them easier to hit with shots.

notes.title: Mechanic adjustments and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Adjustments to dodge and melee mechanics.

Added more ammunition and consumables in the scenarios.

Fixed bugs related to enemies that respawn after being defeated.

notes.title: Optimization and dodge mechanics
notes.notes:
We have optimized lights and textures to give better performance. This may cause some unexpected errors. If so, please contact us at the Community Hub, we will be attentive.

We've also added a new dodge mechanic. When you are very close to an enemy and they are going to attack you, pressing Spacebar will make the character roll on the ground.

This, along with some improvements to the hand-to-hand combat system, will improve the experience when you're running out of ammo or simply prefer to avoid enemies.

notes.title: All voices in spanish!
notes.notes: We have already finished placing all the voices in the game. I estimated that it would take us longer to do it, but in the end we finished earlier and I didn't want to make you wait any longer. Finally you will be able to enjoy 100% of the game with voices in Spanish.

notes.title: More voices in spanish
notes.notes: We finally have the spanish voices for the entire first act of the game. You will soon have the voices for the second act.

notes.title: First voices in Spanish!
notes.notes:
We couldn't wait to show you what we're working on. As you know, at its launch Shadows of Duat already had voices for all the characters in English and screen texts in English and Spanish. From now on you can also enjoy the voices in Spanish.

Although they are all recorded, they are not all implemented yet, as they are time-consuming and our team is small (we are only two people). But the intro of the game is already complete with voices in Spanish and we wanted you to be able to enjoy it as soon as possible. We estimate that the rest of the voices will be ready to be added in a small update in about two weeks.

Tell us what you think of the new voices!

We've also fixed some bugs, such as enemies respawning in certain areas. And an achievement that didn't work properly.
